name: 수정 선인장 온실
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly crystal-cactus greenhouse, gentle elevated view over fine sand beds lined with translucent crystalline cacti in small glowing glass pots; open central foreground, warm desert-amber light contrasts cool moonlit glass ceiling above, richly detailed sand and crystal texture, atmospheric shimmer, polished fantasy concept art, the whole greenhouse glowing with painterly cinematic warmth and gentle desert stillness.
